text:
jess: opened PR to add an observability snippet showing trace->dashboard mappings and a short migration note for label rename. Asking for docs review + link checks.

mike: paste link? I can run a local site build and smoke the examples.

jess: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/901 - includes minimal Python async snippet, tiny JS example, a migration mapping, and an exported dashboard SVG.

link-checker-bot: automated: new PR detected. kicking off link-check and sample build. results to follow.

tara: quick read: the migration blurb replaces `trace_id` with `traceKey`. Our Python SDK examples elsewhere still use `trace_key` (snake_case). We should show both and recommend the SDK param name.

andrew: backend RPC uses `traceKey` (camelCase). Docs should show the canonical runtime field and map to SDK arg. Suggest small mapping table and two inline examples (Python + JS).

jess: will add a tiny mapping table and both examples. keeping text short per docs style.

mike: local build: samples render but Python snippet trips lint for unused import. Also found one hardcoded link to /trace-guide (old path) that still redirects. link-check suggests permanent redirect + update files.

jess: removing the unused import, updating hardcoded link, and adding permanent redirect note to the PR description.

jess: python snippet I'm adding:

from redwood import AsyncClient

async def send_trace(trace_key, spans):
    client = AsyncClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")
    await client.traces.ingest(trace_key=trace_key, spans=spans)
    await client.close()

# migration mapping
# old payload: {"trace_id": "abc123"} -> new: {"traceKey": "abc123"} -> sdk python arg: trace_key

mike: include a 2-line JS snippet as well, and prefer named import style in docs: `import { Client } from 'redwood'`. Also add a one-line caption under the dashboard SVG clarifying p95 vs raw latency.

jess: done: switched JS to named import, added caption clarifying p95 quantile, and attached the SVG.

link-checker-bot: link-check complete: 1 redirect found (/trace-guide -> /observability/traces). Recommended: add permanent redirect rule and update 3 files with relative links.

tara: small nit: the dashboard widget in the screenshot shows metric `request.latency_ms` but our example text refers to `request.latency_ms.p95`. I updated the caption suggestion in the PR to call out which metric is illustrated.

andrew: also add a short entry to the rollout checklist: run smoke query for traces after redirect is live.

jess: updated checklist and caption, removed lint issue, fixed link. pushing commit now.

doc-bot: PR #901 updated: build + link-check + lint passed. awaiting reviewer approval.

mike: left a short review and approved. :thumbsup:

tara: approved.

jess: merged. will follow up with infra to add permanent redirect and with product to include the migration note in release notes. thanks everyone! :party_parrot:
